read.thesis: Volume-led quarter with USG 5.8% and UVG 5.5%, but no capacity signal; pricing only 0.2% in Q2 and management expects price to lead H2 growth, with Brazil tax-driven Q4 destocking risk.

triggers.label: Q2 price only 0.2%
triggers.quote: Pricing in second quarter was 0.2% and 0.6% for the half.

triggers.label: FY USG raised to 4-6%
triggers.quote: we expect underlying sales growth to be within a multiyear range of 4% to 6%

triggers.label: Brazil tax destocking risk Q4
triggers.quote: we expect there could be some bit of destocking in quarter 4

guidance.quote: we expect underlying sales growth to be within a multiyear range of 4% to 6%
with around 3% UVG for the full year
For the second half, we expect growth of 4% to 5%, led by pricing.

guidance.value: H2 gross margin similar to H1 (46.8%)
guidance.quote: we will have gross margins at similar levels. of first half, which is we will take the 46.8% levels.
we continue to expect the full year finance cost to remain below 3%
Our full year expectation remains around 26%.
the full year outcome is approximately EUR 850 million
Based on July spot rates, we expect the full year impact to be around 3%

red_flags.label: US condiments share loss
red_flags.quote: our Condiment business has suffered some share losses

red_flags.label: Brazil tax destocking risk
red_flags.quote: this could actually potentially lead to some market disruptions in quarter 4

evasions.quote: We will not give guidance in the quarter 3 and quarter 4
at this stage, it's difficult to predict elasticity in the future
